summary_1line: Dasaratha, crushed by Kaushalya’s reproaches and Rama’s exile, recalls a past accidental killing and sinks deeper into grief and remorse.

image_candidates.scene_text: King Dasaratha collapses senseless on the palace floor as Queen Kaushalya stands weeping beside him.
The grieving king, head bowed and palms joined, pleads with tearful Queen Kaushalya in the dim royal chamber.
Dasaratha sits in anguish remembering the moment he shot a sound-guided arrow in the forest, unknowingly killing a young ascetic.
